en.q: Which of the following statements about the customer risk assessment described in the AML/CFT Guideline are correct?
statements: The finalised customer risk assessment determines the level and type of transaction monitoring only; the extent of ongoing CDD is the same for every customer whatever the assessment shows
The assessment is of no assistance in differentiating between the risks of individual customers and business relationships, since the same CDD measures are applied to every relationship
An MSO should assess the ML/TF risks associated with a customer or a proposed business relationship, an exercise usually referred to as a customer risk assessment
Where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are higher, the amount and type of information obtained, and the extent to which it is verified, should be increased
Where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are lower, the information obtained and the extent of its verification may be simplified
notes: False: ¶2.14 states the finalised customer risk assessment “determines the level and type of ongoing monitoring (including ongoing CDD and transaction monitoring)”. Ongoing CDD, like transaction monitoring, is scaled to the assessment.

False: ¶2.13 states “The risk assessment conducted will also assist the MSO to differentiate between the risks of individual customers and business relationships”. The assessment assists differentiation; it does not require the same extent of CDD for every relationship.
True: ¶2.13 states “An MSO should assess the ML/TF risks associated with a customer or a proposed business relationship, which is usually referred to as a customer risk assessment”.

True: ¶2.13 states “the amount and type of information obtained, and the extent to which this information is verified, should be increased where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are higher”.
True: ¶2.13 states “It may also be simplified where the ML/TF risks associated with the business relationship are lower”.

An uncertified copy of an entry in the register of licensees costs $160 per copy, the same as a certified copy.

en.q: According to the AML/CFT Guideline, which of the following are correct about the maximum penalties for the main money laundering and terrorist financing offences?
statements: Dealing with property while knowing or having reasonable grounds to believe it represents the proceeds of drug trafficking or of an indictable offence carries up to 14 years' imprisonment and a fine of $5 million.

A person who fails to disclose, as soon as it is reasonable, knowledge or suspicion that property represents another person's proceeds of an indictable offence faces up to 3 months' imprisonment and a fine of $50,000.

Tipping off, that is disclosing a matter likely to prejudice an investigation after knowing or suspecting that a disclosure has been made, carries a maximum of 7 years' imprisonment and a fine on conviction.
Providing or collecting property for terrorists, or making property or financial services available to them, is an offence under the UNATMO punishable by up to 14 years' imprisonment and a fine.
Under the DTROP, the OSCO and the UNATMO, the offence of failing to disclose knowledge or suspicion of the proceeds of crime carries a maximum fine of $500,000 together with 3 months' imprisonment.
notes: Correct: ¶1.22 says the highest penalty for the section 25 dealing offence upon conviction is imprisonment for 14 years and a fine of $5 million.
Correct: ¶1.24 says the failure-to-disclose offence carries a maximum term of imprisonment of 3 months and a fine of $50,000 upon conviction.
Incorrect: ¶1.25 says the maximum penalty for tipping off upon conviction is imprisonment for 3 years and a fine, not 7 years.

Correct: ¶1.23 says the UNATMO criminalises the provision or collection of property and making property or financial services available to terrorists, with a maximum of 14 years' imprisonment and a fine.
Incorrect: ¶1.24 puts the maximum fine for failing to disclose at $50,000, together with 3 months' imprisonment; $500,000 is not the figure.

en.q: According to the AML/CFT Guideline, which of the following correctly name the main pieces of Hong Kong legislation concerned with money laundering, terrorist financing and proliferation financing?
statements: The Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Ordinance, Cap. 405, is, alongside the AMLO, one of the main pieces of legislation in Hong Kong concerned with the laundering of criminal proceeds.
The Organized and Serious Offences Ordinance, Cap. 455, among other things creates the money laundering offence for the proceeds of indictable offences in Hong Kong.

The United Nations (Anti-Terrorism Measures) Ordinance, Cap. 575, criminalises the provision or collection of property, and the making of property or financial services available, to terrorists or terrorist associates.
The Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Supply of Services) Ordinance, Cap. 526, controls the provision of services that may assist the development of weapons of mass destruction.

The Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Ordinance, Cap. 615, imposes customer due diligence and record-keeping requirements on MSOs and gives the CCE powers to supervise compliance with them.
notes: Correct: ¶1.14 lists the Drug Trafficking (Recovery of Proceeds) Ordinance, Cap. 405, among the six main pieces of legislation, and ¶1.19 describes its proceeds provisions.
Incorrect: Cap. 455 is the Organized and Serious Crimes Ordinance; ¶1.14 and ¶1.20 use that name, and "Offences" is not part of it.

Correct: ¶1.23 says the UNATMO, Cap. 575, criminalises the provision or collection of property and the making of property or financial (or related) services available to terrorists or terrorist associates.
Incorrect: Cap. 526 is the Weapons of Mass Destruction (Control of Provision of Services) Ordinance; ¶1.14 and ¶1.27 use "Provision of Services", not "Supply of Services".
Correct: ¶1.15 says the AMLO imposes requirements relating to CDD and record-keeping on MSOs and provides the CCE with powers to supervise compliance with these and other requirements under the AMLO.

en.q: Regarding the seizure and detention of cash-type items (CBNIs) under the Cross-boundary Movement of Physical Currency and Bearer Negotiable Instruments Ordinance, which of the following are correct?
statements: CBNIs seized under section 17 on suspicion that they are crime proceeds or terrorist property may be detained for not more than 10 working days after the day of seizure.
For that purpose a working day is a day that is not a general holiday or a Saturday, and not a black rainstorm warning day or a gale warning day.
A court order authorising the continued detention of the CBNIs may specify a period of up to 6 months beginning on the date of the order.
A new order extending the detention must not result in the total period of detention exceeding 2 years beginning on the date of the first order.
Within the initial detention period, the authorized officer applies to a magistrate for the order authorising the continued detention of the CBNIs.
notes: Correct: s.17(2) lets an authorized officer detain the CBNIs for a period of not more than 10 working days after the day of seizure, subject to sections 18 and 19.
Correct: s.17(4) defines a working day as a day that is not a general holiday or a Saturday, or a black rainstorm warning day or gale warning day.
Incorrect: s.18(3) says the period specified in the order must not exceed 3 months beginning on the date of the order; 6 months is not the limit.
Correct: s.18(5) says a new order must not result in the total period of detention exceeding 2 years beginning on the date of the first order under s.18(2).
Incorrect: s.18(1) has the authorized officer apply to the Court, not a magistrate, for an order authorising continued detention.

en.q: Regarding the period of validity of a money service operator licence and the timing of its renewal under the AMLO, which of the following are correct?

en.q: Regarding a licensee's duties under the AMLO to display its licence and to notify the Commissioner of the cessation of its business, which of the following are correct?

en.q: Regarding the pecuniary penalties the AMLO lets a relevant authority impose on a financial institution for contravening a specified provision, and the Commissioner impose on a money service licensee for licensing breaches, which of the following are correct?

If a financial institution fails to comply with a section 21 remedial order, the relevant authority may further order a daily penalty not exceeding $100,000 for each day the failure continues after the specified date.
If a licensee fails to comply with a section 43 remedial order, the Commissioner may further order a daily pecuniary penalty not exceeding $50,000 for each day on which the failure continues.
notes: Correct: s.21(2)(c) caps the penalty at the greater of $10,000,000 or 3 times the amount of the profit gained, or costs avoided, as a result of the contravention.

en.q: Regarding the penalties the AMLO sets for contravening a specified provision and for failing to comply with a requirement imposed under the routine inspection power, which of the following are correct?
statements: Knowingly contravening a specified provision exposes a financial institution, on conviction on indictment, to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 2 years.

A financial institution that contravenes a specified provision with intent to defraud a relevant authority is liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $1,000,000 and to imprisonment for 5 years.
On summary conviction, contravening a specified provision with intent to defraud a relevant authority carries a fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year.
A person who, without reasonable excuse, fails to comply with a requirement imposed under section 9 is liable on conviction on indictment to a fine of $200,000 and to imprisonment for 1 year.
On summary conviction, failing without reasonable excuse to comply with a section 9 requirement carries a fine at level 6 and imprisonment for 6 months.
notes: Correct: s.5(5)(a) makes a knowing contravention punishable on indictment by a fine of $1,000,000 and imprisonment for 2 years.

Correct: s.5(6)(b) sets the summary penalty for the intent-to-defraud offence at a fine of $500,000 and imprisonment for 1 year.
Correct: s.10(2)(a) makes the unexcused failure punishable on indictment by a fine of $200,000 and imprisonment for 1 year.
Incorrect: s.10(2)(b) sets the summary penalty at a fine at level 5 and imprisonment for 6 months; level 6 is the figure for the section 5 offence.

en.q: Regarding when Schedule 2 to the AMLO requires customer due diligence measures to be carried out, which of the following are correct?
statements: CDD must be carried out before an occasional transaction involving an amount equal to or above $120,000, whether it is carried out in a single operation or in several operations that appear to be linked.

An occasional transaction that is a virtual asset transfer requires CDD where the virtual assets involved amount to no less than $8,000, in one operation or several linked ones.
CDD must be carried out when the institution suspects that the customer or the customer's account is involved in money laundering or terrorist financing, whatever the amount.
Where verifying identity first would interrupt the normal conduct of business, an institution may verify after establishing the business relationship without needing to satisfy any other condition.
notes: Correct: s.3(1)(b) of Schedule 2 requires CDD before an occasional transaction involving an amount equal to or above $120,000, in a single operation or in several operations that appear to be linked.
Incorrect: s.3(1A)(a) of Schedule 2 sets the occasional-transaction threshold for a wire transfer at an amount equal to or above $8,000, not $120,000.

Correct: s.3(1)(d) of Schedule 2 requires CDD when the institution suspects that the customer or the customer's account is involved in money laundering or terrorist financing; no amount is attached.

Incorrect: s.3(2) of Schedule 2 allows later verification only if that is necessary not to interrupt the normal conduct of business and any resulting ML/TF risk is effectively managed; both conditions apply.

en.q: Regarding the product-based simplified due diligence in Schedule 2 to the AMLO and the stored value limit below which Schedule 2 does not apply to a stored value facility, which of the following are correct?
statements: Where the product related to the transaction falls within section 4(5), the institution may carry out only the measures in section 2(1)(a), (ab), (c) and (d) of Schedule 2 instead of all the CDD measures.
A life insurance policy qualifies as such a product where an annual premium of no more than $8,000, or an equivalent amount in another currency, is payable.
A life insurance policy also qualifies where a single premium of no more than $50,000, or an equivalent amount in another currency, is payable.

A retirement scheme qualifies where it provides retirement benefits to employees, contributions are deducted from income from employment and the rules do not permit the assignment of a member's interest.
Schedule 2 applies to the issue of a stored value facility by an SVF licensee or a bank only if the maximum value that can be stored on the facility exceeds $8,000.
notes: Correct: s.4(4) of Schedule 2 lets the institution carry out only the measures in s.2(1)(a), (ab), (c) and (d) where it reasonably believes the product falls within s.4(5).
Correct: s.4(5)(c)(i) of Schedule 2 names a life insurance policy under which an annual premium of no more than $8,000 or an equivalent amount in any other currency is payable.
Incorrect: s.4(5)(c)(ii) of Schedule 2 sets the single-premium limit at no more than $20,000, not $50,000.
Correct: s.4(5)(a) of Schedule 2 describes a provident, pension, retirement or superannuation scheme meeting those three conditions.
Incorrect: s.5(4)(a) of the AMLO applies Schedule 2 to such a stored value facility only if the maximum value that can be stored on it exceeds $3,000, not $8,000.

en.q: Regarding the carrying out of customer due diligence measures by means of an intermediary under Schedule 2 to the AMLO, which of the following are correct?
statements: An institution may use a specified intermediary to carry out a CDD measure only if the intermediary consents in writing to be the institution's intermediary.
The institution must be satisfied that the intermediary will provide copies of the CDD documents, data or information it obtained within 7 days of a request.
An institution that carries out a CDD measure by means of an intermediary remains liable under the Ordinance for any failure to carry out that measure.
An accounting professional, estate agent, legal professional or TCSP licensee is a specified intermediary if it satisfies the institution that it has adequate ML/TF procedures.
A licensed money service operator is among the financial institutions that section 18(3)(b) of Schedule 2 names as specified intermediaries for CDD purposes.
notes: Correct: s.18(1)(a) of Schedule 2 requires the intermediary to consent in writing to be the institution's intermediary.
Incorrect: s.18(1)(b) of Schedule 2 requires the institution to be satisfied that the intermediary will, on request, provide the copies or records without delay; no 7-day period is given.
Correct: s.18(2) of Schedule 2 keeps the institution liable under the Ordinance for a failure to carry out the CDD measure done through an intermediary.
Correct: s.18(3)(a) of Schedule 2 lists those four kinds of person, provided they can satisfy the institution that they have adequate procedures to prevent money laundering and terrorist financing.

Incorrect: s.18(3)(b) of Schedule 2 names authorized institutions, licensed corporations, authorized insurers and licensed insurance agents, agencies and broker companies; a licensed money service operator is not in the list.

en.q: Regarding the special requirements of Schedule 2 to the AMLO for remittance transactions that are not wire transfers, and the definition of an identification document, which of the following are correct?
statements: Section 13 applies to a remittance transaction, other than a wire transfer, carried out by a licensed money service operator and involving an amount equal to or above $8,000 or its equivalent.
Section 13 applies to every remittance transaction of $8,000 or above carried out by a licensed money service operator, including one that is a wire transfer.
Before carrying out the remittance transaction, the operator must verify the originator's identity by reference to the originator's identification document.
For an individual, an identification document means an identity card, certificate of identity, document of identity or travel document as defined by the Registration of Persons Ordinance (Cap. 177).
For the purposes of section 13, a remittance transaction means a transaction for sending, or arranging for the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong.
notes: Correct: s.13(1) of Schedule 2 applies the section to a remittance transaction, other than a wire transfer, involving an amount equal to or above $8,000 or an equivalent amount, carried out by a licensed money service operator.
Incorrect: s.13(1) of Schedule 2 excludes a wire transfer; wire transfers are dealt with under section 12.
Correct: s.13(2)(b) of Schedule 2 requires the operator to verify the identity of the originator by reference to the originator's identification document.
Incorrect: s.1(1) of Schedule 2 defines those documents by reference to section 2(1) of the Immigration Ordinance (Cap. 115), not the Registration of Persons Ordinance.
Correct: s.13(3) of Schedule 2 defines a remittance transaction as a transaction for sending, or arranging for the sending of, money to a place outside Hong Kong.

en.q: Regarding the special requirements of Schedule 2 to the AMLO for a customer who has not been physically present for identification purposes, which of the following are correct?
statements: The institution must carry out at least one of the measures listed in section 9(1); it is not required to carry out all of the listed measures before taking on the customer concerned.

One listed measure is further verifying the customer's identity on the basis of documents, data or information not previously used to verify that identity under Schedule 2.
One listed measure is ensuring the customer's first payment comes from an account in the customer's name with an authorized institution or a qualifying institution in an equivalent jurisdiction.
The first-payment measure is satisfied where the payment comes from an account held in the name of any third party whom the customer nominates for the purpose.
notes: Correct: s.9(1) of Schedule 2 requires the institution to carry out at least one of the listed measures.
Incorrect: s.9(1) of Schedule 2 says at least one measure; it does not require two.

en.q: According to the Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment, which of the following are correct about results, re-checking and re-taking the Assessment?
statements: Candidates are notified of the Assessment result, PASS or FAIL, by e-mail only, within 14 days after the Assessment, and should keep the notification.
A candidate who is not satisfied with the result may write for re-checking of the Assessment papers within 14 days after the date of issuance of the result notification.
The re-checking result is sent in writing within 14 days after receipt of the request, and the answer sheet is re-checked for technical errors such as incorrect mark entries.
On re-checking, the C&ED will disclose the candidate's exact score to the candidate, although not the Assessment questions or the correct answers.
For granting a licence, an eligible person who fails may be arranged to re-take the Assessment after 30 days upon the notification of result.
notes: Correct: ¶12.1 says candidates will only be notified of the results, PASS or FAIL, by e-mail only within 14 days after the Assessment.
Incorrect: ¶12.2 allows the re-checking request within seven days after the date of issuance of the result notification, not 14 days; late submission is not considered.
Correct: ¶12.3 says the result is sent in writing within 14 days after receipt of the re-checking request and that the answer sheet is re-checked for technical errors.
Incorrect: ¶12.4 says the C&ED will not disclose the exact scores, the Assessment questions or the corresponding correct answers in any case.
Correct: ¶4.5 gives the applicant another opportunity to arrange the eligible person to re-take the Assessment after 30 days upon the notification of result.

en.q: According to the Guidance Notes on the Competence Assessment, which of the following are correct about nominating eligible persons for the Assessment?

Because the Assessment is conducted on a company basis, the candidates of the same company under an application or licence must attend the same session in all circumstances.
A licensee may nominate eligible persons within 90 days before the expiry of the licence where it has no eligible person who has passed the Assessment.
A licensee may nominate further eligible persons at any time it wishes to add a passed eligible person, in addition to the circumstances listed in the Guidance Notes.
notes: Correct: ¶4.2(i)(b) says not more than THREE partners can be nominated to participate in the Assessment.
Incorrect: ¶4.2(ii)(b) limits the nomination to not more than THREE directors, not five.

en.q: Regarding the periods, units and penalties in the Money Changers Ordinance, Cap. 34, which of the following are correct?
statements: A money changer shall retain the duplicate copy of a completed transaction note for not less than 12 months and produce it for inspection and copying on demand by a police officer.
Where a money changer contravenes section 4 in respect of an exchange transaction, the other party may rescind the transaction within 7 days after the date of the transaction.
A money changer may display a net rate of exchange in multiple units of 10 or 100 units of foreign currency with a corresponding adjustment to the Hong Kong dollar figure.
A money changer who contravenes section 4(1), (3) to (8) or (10) is liable to a fine at level 1 for a first offence, and to a fine at level 2 and 6 months' imprisonment for a later offence.
A money changer who contravenes section 6 on displaying rates of exchange is liable to a fine at level 1 only, with no term of imprisonment attached.
notes: Correct: s.4(8) requires the duplicate copy of a completed transaction note to be retained for not less than 12 months and produced on demand by a police officer.
Incorrect: s.5 allows the other party to rescind the transaction within 3 days after the date of the transaction, not 7 days.
Correct: s.6(6) lets a money changer display a net rate in multiple units of 10 or 100 units of foreign currency with a corresponding adjustment to the Hong Kong dollar figure.
Correct: s.4(11) sets a fine at level 1 for a first offence and a fine at level 2 and imprisonment for 6 months for a second or subsequent offence.
Incorrect: s.6(7) makes a contravention of section 6 punishable by a fine at level 2 and imprisonment for 6 months.

Under both guidelines, as a matter of policy the CCE will usually publicise all his decisions to impose a pecuniary penalty on an MSO.
Under the Disciplinary Fining Guideline, a breach of a licence condition counts as a contravention of a specified provision and is fined under section 21.
notes: Correct: ¶3 of the April 2018 guideline says it is published under section 45(1) to indicate how the CCE will exercise the power conferred by section 43(2)(c).
Incorrect: ¶2 of the May 2018 guideline says it is published under section 23(1) of the AMLO and concerns the fining power under section 21(2)(c).
Correct: ¶1 of the May 2018 guideline applies to an MSO that contravenes a specified provision as defined by section 5(11) of the AMLO.
Correct: ¶4 of the April 2018 guideline and ¶3 of the May 2018 guideline both say the CCE will usually publicise all his decisions to impose pecuniary penalty.

Incorrect: ¶1 of the May 2018 guideline confines the section 21 power to a contravention of a specified provision as defined by section 5(11); a breach of a licence condition is a section 43 ground listed in ¶1(b) of the April 2018 guideline.

en.q: According to the AML/CFT Guideline, which of the following are correct about keeping the institutional ML/TF risk assessment up to date?
statements: An MSO should conduct its institutional ML/TF risk assessment every two years and upon trigger events which are material to its business and risk exposure.
The results of the review of the institutional risk assessment should be documented and approved by the MSO's Money Laundering Reporting Officer.
Trigger events may include a significant breach of the AML/CFT Systems, the acquisition of new customer segments or delivery channels, or the launch of new products.
An MSO should keep records of the institutional risk assessment, including the risk factors identified and assessed and the information sources taken into account.
Once documented, the institutional ML/TF risk assessment need only be repeated every three years, unless a material trigger event occurs in the meantime.
notes: Correct: ¶2.9 says an MSO should conduct its assessment every two years and upon trigger events which are material to the MSO's business and risk exposure.
Incorrect: ¶2.9 says the results of the review should be documented and approved by the MSO's senior management, not the MLRO.
Correct: ¶2.9 lists those examples of trigger events, together with significant changes to operational processes, target customers and business counterparts.
Correct: ¶2.10 says an MSO should maintain records of the institutional ML/TF risk assessment, including the risk factors identified and assessed and the information sources taken into account.
Incorrect: ¶2.9 sets the regular cycle at every two years; three years is not the interval.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關確保機構層面洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估反映現況的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 金錢服務經營者應每兩年進行一次機構層面的風險評估，並在會顯著影響其業務及所面對風險的觸發事件發生後覆核評估。
機構層面風險評估的覆核結果應記錄在案，並由金錢服務經營者的洗錢報告主任審批。
觸發事件可包括嚴重違反打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度、收購新的客戶類別或交付渠道，或推出新的產品及服務。
金錢服務經營者應備存機構層面風險評估的紀錄，包括所識別及評估的風險因素及所考慮的資料來源。
機構層面的風險評估一經記錄在案，除非有重大觸發事件發生，否則每三年重新進行一次即可。
notes: 正確：第2.9段訂明金錢服務經營者應每兩年進行一次評估，並在會顯著影響其業務及所面對風險的觸發事件發生後覆核評估。

正確：第2.9段列出該等觸發事件例子，以及營運程序、目標客戶及交易對手有重大改變的情況。
正確：第2.10段訂明金錢服務經營者應備存機構層面風險評估的紀錄，包括所識別及評估的風險因素及所考慮的資料來源。
不正確：第2.9段訂明的定期週期是每兩年一次，並非三年。

en.q: According to the Guidelines for Submission of Business Plan, which of the following are correct about the information an applicant must provide?
statements: The applicant should provide the expected profit margin and turnover for each type of product and service for the next two years, and the running capital for daily operation.
The applicant should provide the account number and the owner of any bank account used for the business, and no third party bank account is allowed.
An applicant that considers it has no need to open a bank account for the business may simply state so in the business plan without further explanation.
The applicant must confirm in writing in the business plan that any change in the particulars provided to the Commissioner will be notified in writing within one month.
The business plan need not mention the business logo or the trademark that the applicant will use to promote the money service business.
notes: Correct: item 9 asks for the expected profit margin and turnover on each type of product and service for the next two years and the running capital for daily operation.
Correct: item 8 asks for the account number and owner of any bank account used for the business and states that no third party bank account is allowed.
Incorrect: the note to item 8 requires such an applicant to provide details on how the company will provide money service without a bank account.
Correct: the preamble requires written confirmation that the licensee will notify the Commissioner in writing of any change within one month beginning on the date on which the change takes place.
Incorrect: item 1 asks for the company name, business name, website address, business logo and trademark used to promote the money service business.

tc.q: 根據《遞交業務計劃的指引》，以下有關申請人須提供的資料的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 申請人應就未來兩年每類產品及服務的預計利潤幅度和營業額，以及業務日常運作的營運資本提供資料。
申請人應提供用以經營業務的銀行戶口的帳戶號碼及擁有人，且不得使用第三方銀行戶口。
申請人如認為無需開設銀行戶口，在業務計劃內說明此點即可，而無需作進一步解釋。
申請人須在業務計劃內藉書面確認，提供予關長的詳情如有改變，會在自改變發生之日起計的一個月內藉書面具報。
業務計劃無需提及申請人將用作推廣其金錢服務業務的業務標誌或商標等有關資料。

en.q: According to the AML/CFT Guideline, which of the following are correct about the Compliance Officer and the Money Laundering Reporting Officer of an MSO?
statements: Compliance management arrangements should, at a minimum, include oversight by senior management and the appointment of a Compliance Officer and a Money Laundering Reporting Officer.
Senior management should appoint a CO at management level with overall responsibility for the AML/CFT Systems, and a senior staff member as MLRO and central reference point for STRs.
The Compliance Officer and the Money Laundering Reporting Officer must always be two different persons, whatever the size of the MSO and its business.
Senior management should, as far as practicable, ensure that the CO and MLRO are normally based in Hong Kong and of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the MSO.
It is the MLRO, rather than the CO, who is responsible for developing and continuously reviewing the MSO's AML/CFT Systems to keep them up to date.
notes: Correct: ¶3.5 says compliance management arrangements should, at a minimum, include oversight by senior management and the appointment of a CO and an MLRO.

Correct: ¶3.7 says senior management should appoint a CO at the management level with overall responsibility for the AML/CFT Systems and a senior staff as the MLRO to act as the central reference point for suspicious transaction reporting.
Incorrect: footnote 9 says that, depending on the size of an MSO, the functions of CO and MLRO may be performed by the same person.
Correct: ¶3.8(c) and (d) say the CO and MLRO should be normally based in Hong Kong and of a sufficient level of seniority and authority within the MSO.
Incorrect: ¶3.9(a) gives the CO responsibility for developing and/or continuously reviewing the MSO's AML/CFT Systems.

tc.q: 根據《打擊洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集指引》，以下有關金錢服務經營者的合規主任及洗錢報告主任的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 合規管理安排最低限度應包括由高級管理層監督，以及委任一名合規主任及一名洗錢報告主任。
高級管理層應委任一名屬管理層的合規主任全面負責打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度，並委任一名高級職員擔任洗錢報告主任。
不論金錢服務經營者的規模及業務如何，合規主任及洗錢報告主任必須由兩名不同的人分別擔任。
高級管理層應在切實可行的範圍內，確保合規主任及洗錢報告主任通常長駐香港，並在該經營者具有一定的資歷及權力。
負責制訂及持續覆核金錢服務經營者的打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的是洗錢報告主任，而非合規主任。
notes: 正確：第3.5段訂明合規管理安排最低限度應包括由高級管理層監督，以及委任一名合規主任及一名洗錢報告主任。
正確：第3.7段訂明高級管理層應委任一名屬管理層的合規主任全面負責制度，並委任一名高級職員擔任洗錢報告主任，作為報告可疑交易的中央聯絡點。
不正確：註9訂明合規主任及洗錢報告主任的職能可由同一人執行，視乎金錢服務經營者的規模而定。
正確：第3.8(c)及(d)段訂明合規主任及洗錢報告主任應通常長駐香港，並在該經營者具有一定的資歷及權力。
不正確：第3.9(a)段把制訂及╱或持續覆核打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度的責任交予合規主任。

en.q: According to the Hong Kong ML/TF Risk Assessment Report 2022, which of the following are correct about the Joint Financial Intelligence Unit (JFIU) and the suspicious transaction reports it receives?
statements: The JFIU is the dedicated unit of the Hong Kong Police Force and the C&ED together, which receives, analyses and disseminates STRs filed by FIs, DNFBPs and members of the public.
The JFIU is operated by the Hong Kong Police Force alone; the C&ED is involved only when an STR concerns a customs offence such as smuggling.
On receipt of each STR, the JFIU conducts intelligence analysis under its risk-assessment mechanism, examining the report's degree of suspicion, severity and level of risk.
The number of STRs reached its peak in 2019, when 51 588 reports were filed, partly because of an improving compliance culture since the AMLO took effect.
The Financial Investigations, JFIU and Risk Assessment formations were detached from the Narcotics Bureau to form the FIIB with effect from 1 June 2021.
notes: Correct: ¶3.38 describes the JFIU as the dedicated unit jointly operated by the HKPF and the C&ED to receive, analyse and disseminate STRs filed by FIs, DNFBPs and members of the public.
Incorrect: ¶3.38 says the JFIU is jointly operated by the HKPF and the C&ED; the C&ED is a joint operator, not an occasional participant.

Correct: ¶3.38 says that on receipt of each STR the JFIU examines it and conducts intelligence analysis under its risk-assessment mechanism, looking at its degree of suspicion, severity and level of risk.
Incorrect: ¶3.39 says the number of STRs peaked in 2017 and then dropped to 51 588 in 2019 after outreach work improved STR quality.
Correct: ¶3.30 says the three formations were detached from the NB to form a new FIIB with effect from 1 June 2021.

tc.q: 根據《香港洗錢及恐怖分子資金籌集風險評估報告》2022，以下有關聯合財富情報組及其接收的可疑交易報告的陳述，哪些正確？
statements: 聯合財富情報組由警務處和海關共同組成，專責接收、分析及發布金融機構、指定非金融業人士和市民提交的可疑交易報告。
聯合財富情報組由警務處單獨運作；海關在可疑交易報告涉及走私等海關職權範圍內的罪行時才會參與其中。
每當接獲可疑交易報告，聯合財富情報組會按風險評估機制審視報告內容，包括可疑情況、嚴重程度和風險水平，並進行情報分析。

en.q: According to the AML/CFT Guideline, which of the following are correct about the records an MSO keeps of internal ML/TF reports and of STRs made to the JFIU?
statements: The record of ML/TF reports made to the MLRO should include the report's date, the staff subsequently handling it, the assessment results and where the papers can be located.
Keeping a record of all ML/TF reports made to the MLRO is recommended but optional, since only STRs actually filed with the JFIU must be recorded.
The record of STRs made to the JFIU should include the date of the STR, the person who made it and information to allow the papers relevant to it to be located.
The internal-report record need not say whether the report led to an STR to the JFIU, since that information appears in the STR register instead.
The register of STRs made to the JFIU may be combined with the register of internal reports made to the MLRO, if considered appropriate.
notes: Correct: ¶7.29 lists the date the report was made, the staff members subsequently handling the report, the results of the assessment and information to allow the relevant papers to be located, as well as whether an STR followed.
Incorrect: ¶7.29 says an MSO must establish and maintain a record of all ML/TF reports made to the MLRO; it is a requirement, not an option.
Correct: ¶7.30 says the record should include the date of the STR, the person who made the STR and information to allow the relevant papers to be located.
Incorrect: ¶7.29 lists whether the internal report resulted in an STR to the JFIU among the details the record of internal reports should include.
Correct: ¶7.30 says the STR register may be combined with the register of internal reports, if considered appropriate.

en.q: According to the AML/CFT Guideline, which of the following are correct about staff training and training records?
statements: Whatever training approach is adopted, an MSO should monitor and keep records of who has been trained, when the staff received the training and the type of training provided.
Training records should be kept for a minimum of 7 years, the same period for which an MSO keeps its transaction records under the AMLO.
For all new staff, irrespective of seniority, appropriate training may include an introduction to the background to ML/TF and to reporting suspicious transactions to the MLRO and tipping-off.
An MSO may consider including available FATF papers and typologies in its training materials, and should be able to demonstrate to the CCE that all materials are up to date.
Back-office staff need no AML/CFT training, since the training programme in the Guideline is directed at staff who deal directly with the public.
notes: Correct: ¶9.7 says an MSO should monitor and maintain records of who have been trained, when the staff received the training and the type of the training provided.
Incorrect: ¶9.7 says training records should be maintained for a minimum of 3 years, not 7 years.

Correct: ¶9.5(a) says that, for all new staff irrespective of seniority, appropriate training may include an introduction to the background to ML/TF and to the need to identify and report suspicious transactions to the MLRO and the offence of tipping-off.

Correct: ¶9.6 says an MSO may consider including available FATF papers and typologies as part of the training materials and should be able to demonstrate to the CCE that all materials are up-to-date and in line with current requirements and standards.
Incorrect: ¶9.5(c) sets out training for back-office staff on customer verification, processing procedures and recognising unusual activities.

en.q: According to the AML/CFT Guideline, which of the following are correct about an MSO's independent audit function?
statements: An MSO should establish an independent audit function with a direct line of communication to senior management and sufficient expertise and resources for its work.
The audit function's regular review should cover the adequacy of the AML/CFT Systems, the effectiveness of STR systems and the compliance function, and staff awareness.
The Guideline fixes the audit function's review of the AML/CFT Systems at once every calendar year for every MSO, regardless of its size or risk.
Where appropriate, the MSO should also seek a review of its AML/CFT Systems from external parties in addition to its own independent audit function.
The independent audit function reports to the Compliance Officer, who decides which of its findings are passed on to the MSO's senior management.
notes: Correct: ¶3.11 says the independent audit function should have a direct line of communication to senior management and sufficient expertise and resources to carry out its responsibilities.

Correct: ¶3.12 lists the adequacy of the AML/CFT Systems, risk assessment framework and RBA, the effectiveness of STR systems and of the compliance function, and the level of awareness of staff with AML/CFT responsibilities.
Incorrect: ¶3.13 says the frequency and extent of the review should be commensurate with the nature, size and complexity of the business and its ML/TF risks; no fixed annual interval is set.
Correct: ¶3.13 says that, where appropriate, the MSO should also seek a review from external parties.
Incorrect: ¶3.11 gives the audit function a direct line of communication to senior management; it does not route through the CO.

statements: 金錢服務經營者應設立獨立的審核職能，該職能應能與高級管理層直接溝通，並具備充足的專門知識及資源以履行職責。

在適當情況下，金錢服務經營者除本身的獨立審核職能外，亦應尋求外界對其打擊洗錢／恐怖分子資金籌集制度進行覆核。

en.q: According to the AML/CFT Guideline, which of the following are correct about originator information that an ordering institution chooses not to include in a wire transfer?
statements: For a domestic wire transfer, an ordering institution may include only the originator's account number or, if there is no account, a unique reference number, provided it permits traceability.
An ordering institution that omits complete originator information must provide it within 3 business days after a request from the institution it passes the instruction to, or from the CCE.
The complete originator information must be provided within 3 business days after the wire transfer is sent, whether or not any request for it is received.
Such information should be made available to law enforcement agencies immediately upon request, without waiting for the 3 business days allowed to other requesters.
The option to omit complete originator information applies equally to cross-border wire transfers, provided the account or reference number permits traceability.
notes: Correct: ¶10.11 allows, for a domestic wire transfer, including only the originator's account number or a unique reference number, provided that the number permits traceability of the wire transfer.
Correct: ¶10.12 requires the complete required originator information within 3 business days after the request from the receiving institution or the CCE is received.
Incorrect: ¶10.12 runs the 3 business days from receipt of a request; there is no duty to send the information unasked within 3 business days of the transfer.
Correct: ¶10.12 says such information should be made available to law enforcement agencies immediately upon request.

Incorrect: ¶10.11 confines the option to domestic wire transfers; the batch-file arrangement in ¶10.10 for overseas recipients is different, because the batch file must still carry complete originator and recipient information.

statements: 就本地電傳轉帳，匯款機構可僅加入匯款人的戶口號碼或（如沒有戶口）獨特參考編號，但該號碼必須可用作追蹤有關電傳轉帳。

不論有否接獲任何要求，全部所需匯款人資料均須在電傳轉帳發出後的3個營業日內主動提供。
該等資料亦需按執法機構要求立即提供，不能等待向其他要求者提供資料的3個營業日期限。

en.q: According to the AML/CFT Guideline, which of the following are correct about the amount thresholds for occasional transactions and third-party cash transactions?
statements: When a person not named on an account's mandate undertakes a cash transaction of $120,000 or more, the MSO should ask for that person's identity document and retain a copy.
The third-party cash transaction rule in the Guideline applies once the cash involved reaches $8,000, the same threshold as applies to a wire transfer.
An MSO should be vigilant that linked occasional transactions could meet or exceed the $8,000 threshold for wire or virtual asset transfers and the $120,000 threshold for others.
The suspicion of ML/TF criterion for carrying out CDD applies irrespective of the $120,000 or $8,000 thresholds that apply to occasional transactions.

notes: Correct: ¶4.2.6 says that when a cash transaction involving an amount equal to or exceeding $120,000 is undertaken by a person not on the mandate, the MSO should ask for the person's identity document and retain a copy.
Incorrect: ¶4.2.6 sets the third-party cash transaction amount at $120,000 or more; $8,000 is the wire transfer threshold in ¶4.2.1.

en.q: According to the AML/CFT Guideline, which of the following are correct about identifying and verifying a customer who is a natural person?
statements: An MSO should identify the customer by obtaining at least the full name, date of birth, nationality, and the unique identification number and document type.
The identification information required at a minimum consists of three items: the full name, the date of birth and the identity card or passport number.
An MSO should verify the name, date of birth, unique identification number and document type against reliable sources such as a Hong Kong identity card or passport.
An identification document without a photograph may be accepted as a matter of routine, provided the customer's other identification details match.
An MSO should obtain the residential address information of a customer that is a natural person, in addition to the identification information.
notes: Correct: ¶4.3.2 lists full name, date of birth, nationality, and unique identification number and document type as the minimum identification information.

statements: 金錢服務經營者最低限度應收集全名、出生日期、國籍，以及獨特識別號碼及文件的類別，以識別客戶。

凡客戶的其他識別資料相符，沒有照片的身分證明文件可作為常規接納，無需另行評估風險。

en.q: According to the AML/CFT Guideline, which of the following are correct about the record an MSO makes before a remittance transaction that is not a wire transfer?
statements: Before a remittance of $8,000 or above, the MSO must record the originator's name and address, the currency and amount, and the date and time of receipt of the instruction.
The recording duty applies only to remittance transactions of $120,000 or above, or an equivalent amount in another currency, that are not wire transfers.
The MSO must also record the recipient's identification document number, together with the recipient's name and address and the method of delivery.
The MSO must record the originator's identification document number and, if that document is a travel document, the place of issue of the travel document.
The MSO should be able to justify that it kept the originator and transaction records in accordance with Chapter 8, so the information can be made available to the CCE.
notes: Correct: ¶11.6 lists the originator's name, the originator's address, the currency and amount involved, and the date and time of receipt of the instruction among the items to be recorded for a remittance of $8,000 or above.
Incorrect: ¶11.6 sets the threshold at $8,000 or above, or an equivalent amount in any other currency, not $120,000.
Incorrect: ¶11.6 requires the recipient's name and address and the method of delivery; it does not call for the recipient's identification document number.
Correct: ¶11.6 requires the originator's identification document number and, if the identification document is a travel document, the place of issue of the travel document.
Correct: ¶11.6 says the MSO should be able to justify that it has taken steps in accordance with Chapter 8 to keep the records with a view to making the information available to the CCE.
